# SHARPpy Reimagined Skew-T → Rust/egui port

## Goal

Reproduce, pixel-faithfully, the Skew-T sounding panel of
[SHARPpy-Reimagined-vRust](https://github.com/FahrenheitResearch/SHARPpy-Reimagined-vRust)
(see `examples/example_sounding.png` in that repo, left panel) as a reusable
egui widget for embedding in an existing egui app.

## Scope

The skew-T panel only, exactly as `sharppy.viz.skew.plotSkewT` (SHARPpy
1.4.0a5) renders it plus the SHARPpy-Reimagined overlays:

- log-p / skewed-T background: dashed isotherms (blue at 0/-20 °C), dry
  adiabats, mixing-ratio lines with labels, isobar lines/ticks/labels,
  isotherm labels, frame.
- Environment traces: temperature (red, 3 px), dewpoint (green, 3 px),
  wetbulb (cyan, 1 px), virtual temperature (red dashed, 1 px), with surface
  value labels in °F.
- Parcel virtual-temperature trace (white dashed) for a selectable parcel
  (SFC / ML / FCST / MU — default MU, matching the renderer), downdraft
  parcel trace (magenta dashed).
- CAPE fill (orange, rgba 255,130,0,80) / CIN fill (blue, rgba 30,120,255,70)
  between parcel and environment virtual-temperature traces.
- HGZ (-10…-30 °C) dashed cyan band boundaries + label.
- LCL/LFC/EL markers, 0/-20/-30 °C level markers with heights in ft,
  effective inflow layer bracket + ESRH label, max 2-6 km lapse-rate bracket,
  height markers (0-15 km AGL), omega profile meter, speed-colored wind
  barbs (SHARPpy-Reimagined custom color table), title.
- Space Grotesk bundled font (optional install helper).

Out of scope (separate widgets in the original): wind-speed-vs-height strip,
inferred temp advection strip, hodograph, insets, tables; ensemble members;
interactive readout/drag editing.

## Architecture

Pure-Rust crate `sharppyrs`, one dependency (`egui`).

- `constants` / `utils` / `thermo` / `interp` / `winds` / `params`: faithful
  ports of the corresponding `sharppy.sharptab` routines (Wobus moist
  adiabats, parcelx, cape, effective inflow layer, Bunkers motion, helicity,
  DCAPE, max lapse rate...). `f64`, NaN = masked.
- `profile`: `SoundingData` (raw arrays) → `Profile` (derived arrays +
  parcels + effective layer + ESRH + storm motion + traces), computed once.
- `skewt`: `SkewT<'_>` egui widget — geometry/transform port of
  `backgroundSkewT` (lpad 46, rpad 65, tpad/bpad 20, pmax 1050, pmin 100,
  skew 100/3°) and the full `plotData` draw pass in original z-order.
- `barbs`: wind barb path building + speed color table.
- `fonts`: embedded Space Grotesk, `install_fonts(ctx)`.

## Verification

- Golden tests: `testdata/golden.json` generated by running the vendored
  SHARPpy 1.4.0a5 Python code on the repo's example HRRR sounding
  (`hrrr_point_36.68N_95.66W_f018.npz`); Rust results must match (tolerance
  1e-4 relative for iterative routines).
- Visual: eframe demo + headless snapshot rendered with the same sounding,
  compared against the original render.
